title: Deccan Canopy Oasis
sensory: Breathe in the warmth of the air, feel the gentle breeze rustle through leaves overhead. Listen to the vibrant symphony of bird song as you soak in the dappled sunlight filtering through the canopy. Notice the scent of damp earth and decaying leaves.
brain_prompt: Close your eyes and take a moment to feel the weight of your body as you stand beneath the canopy.  What patterns do you see in the branches?
